name: GitLab
description: Built-in GitLab plugin for gitlab.com, self-hosted, and multiple instances. Add an instance URL and api-scope token for 107 operations covering issues, merge requests, reviews, repositories, CI, releases, and search. The host encrypts each token and uses it only for its matching instance.
whenToUse: Use for gitlab.com, company, or self-hosted GitLab; use GitHub for github.com. Supports issues, merge requests, reviews, merges, rebases, repositories, branches, commits, files, CI, releases, search, logs, and archives. Add an instance and token in the plugin details first.

list_tools.description: List this plugin's 107 GitLab operations across issues, merge_requests, repo, commits, events, search, projects, users, pipelines, jobs, discussions, approvals, draft_notes, reactions, groups, environments, wiki, snippets, releases, and meta. With no category, return category names, counts, and descriptions; with a category, return every operation in that category with its description and parameters.

call_tool.description: Run a GitLab operation returned by list_tools, passing args according to its parameter schema. Project operations require project_path such as group/subgroup/project, which may be derived from git remote get-url origin. With multiple instances, set instance to a connection ID or instance URL; omission uses the default connection. Avatar and _links fields are removed by default; set raw=true for original JSON. Results over 50KB are written to the session work directory and only the file path is returned; out_file can set the path. Repository archive downloads require top-level save_dir in ghost_call. upload_project_file requires user media in top-level attachments.
